title: Live Pet Health Guarantee Terms: Return of a Healthy Animal for Rehoming
content:
## Terms

1. A healthy animal bought under the Live Pet Health Guarantee may be brought back for rehoming where the rehoming period of its guarantee type is above 0.
2. A healthy return is accepted only if it is made no later than the rehoming period after the purchase date. The return window is counted in calendar days from the purchase date on the guarantee, that date being day 0, and a return on the last day of the window is made no later than the period and is accepted.
3. The remedy is the healthy-return remedy of the guarantee type, worth the type's share of the price paid.
4. Fish, invertebrates and corals are not taken back healthy.

## The terms by condition and result

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| Rehoming period of the type is 0 | no healthy return under the type |
| The animal is a fish, an invertebrate or a coral | not taken back healthy |
| Return made after the last day of the window | not accepted |
| Return accepted | the healthy-return remedy of the type, worth the type's share of the price paid |

The purchase date that starts the window is the purchase date recorded on the guarantee for that purchase line.

## The window worked through (hypothetical dates)

For a guarantee type with a 14-day rehoming period and a purchase dated 3 May:

| Return date | Day count | Made no later than the period? |
|---|---|---|
| 3 May | day 0 | Yes |
| 17 May | day 14, the last day | Yes |
| 18 May | day 15 | No |

## Value worked through (hypothetical price)

A healthy return of one animal whose price paid was 40.00 USD, under a type whose remedy is store credit worth 75% of the price paid, gives store credit of 40.00 USD multiplied by 75%, that is 30.00 USD. Under a type whose share is 100%, the same price gives 40.00 USD of store credit.
